name: Publuu Flipbook
author: publuu

sections.description:
Turn your static PDFs into interactive, realistic online flipbooks with Publuu. This plugin allows you to easily upload, convert, and embed digital publications directly inside your WordPress posts and pages using a Gutenberg block or Shortcode.

Key Features:

  • Realistic Effect: Smooth page-turning animations that mimic real books.
  • Easy Embedding: Use the custom “Publuu” Gutenberg block or a simple shortcode.
  • Responsive: Flipbooks look great on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.
  • Customization: Add your own branding, background colors, and styles.
  • Cloud Hosting: Your flipbooks are processed and hosted on Publuu’s secure cloud for fast loading.

Service Disclosure:

This plugin relies on a 3rd party service, Publuu.com, to function.
* Service functionality: The plugin transmits your uploaded PDF file to Publuu’s infrastructure (via AWS S3) to convert it into the flipbook format.
* Account requirement: You need a Publuu account to use this plugin. You can create one here.
* Data usage: The PDF file is processed and stored on Publuu servers (AWS) to serve the flipbook viewer on your site.
* Legal: Please review Publuu’s Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WP Dashboard > Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for ‘Publuu Flipbook’.
  3. Click ‘Install Now’ and then ‘Activate’.
  4. Go to the ‘Publuu’ menu in your sidebar.
  5. Connect your account (or register if you haven’t already).
  6. Upload a PDF to create your first flipbook.
  7. Use the ‘Publuu’ block in any post or page to display it.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need to connect the plugin to a Publuu account. The plugin handles the connection securely to manage your flipbooks.

What file formats are supported?

The plugin supports PDF files.

Is it mobile friendly?

Yes, the flipbooks created with Publuu are fully responsive and touch-optimized for mobile devices.

Where are my files stored?

Your original PDF is uploaded to your WordPress Media Library, and the converted flipbook version is hosted securely on Publuu’s cloud servers to ensure high performance and fast loading speeds for your visitors.
